subject.title: fix(telegram): Allow multi-agent ACP bindings within same account

question: Should Telegram allow true simultaneous same-account ACP bindings in one topic, or only allow a same-account handoff where the newest binding owns that topic?
rationale: Current docs and routing resolve one binding for a conversation, while the PR text asks for independent same-topic sessions; choosing that model changes session routing semantics beyond a mechanical owner-fence fix.

options.title: Keep Single-Owner Handoff
options.body: Rework the PR to preserve current storage and exports while allowing same-account rebinding as an explicit ownership switch.

options.title: Design True Multi-Binding
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define how same-topic messages, labels, completions, and close/reset commands choose among multiple active ACP sessions.

options.title: Reject Same-Topic Sharing
options.body: Close or narrow the change if one ACP owner per topic remains the desired product contract and users should use separate topics for independent agents.

recommendation.title: Keep Single-Owner Handoff
recommendation.body: Rework the PR to preserve current storage and exports while allowing same-account rebinding as an explicit ownership switch.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the most relevant storage and binding contract history for the affected Telegram files.
